name: Member's Mark Fully Cooked Thick Cut Bacon (Refrigerated 100-Pack)
whyItWorks: Pre-cooked thick cut hardwood smoked bacon has much of its liquid rendering fat cooked out during factory processing. Crisping gently between paper towels leaves a savory, low-carb garnish with zero fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dab thoroughly with paper towels to absorb excess surface grease. Limit to 1-2 strips to prevent fat-induced diarrhea.
